## Born Beneath the Waves

Fish-men are ten times stronger than humans from birth, and breathe as easily underwater as on land.

Be of the Fish-Man race.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Romance Dawn](01_romance_dawn.md#q-3701db37ab2d99d1)

**Tasks**

- Be of the Fish-Man race

**Rewards**

- Doriki +90, Belly +2,000, +2 Training Points (your race)

## Uchimizu

A flick of the wrist turns a cup of water into a bullet. That is where Fish-Man Karate begins.

Unlock Uchimizu.

## Arlong Park

Arlong told every fish-man that humans were inferior, and built a park in the East Blue to prove it.

Land on a village in East Blue and defeat Arlong.

## The Sun Pirates

The Sun Pirates hid their slave brands under a red sun, so nobody could tell who had been a slave.

Free three slaves and land on Mariejois.

**Tasks**

- Land on Mariejois

Unlock Two-Fish Engine and reach 40,000 Doriki.

## The Fishman Jujutsu

Hack's grappling art turns a bigger foe's strength against him, in the water and out of it.

Take up the Fishman Jujutsu: find a master of the school (a mentor; sneak and talk to them) and be taken in. Any fighter can learn it. The school teaches its techniques for nothing as your Doriki grows; the ability tree shows them, but only the school opens them.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Romance Dawn](01_romance_dawn.md#q-3701db37ab2d99d1)

**Tasks**

- Be taken into the Fishman Jujutsu

**Rewards**

- Doriki +150, Belly +5,000

<a id="q-6253f0af7f5ba42d"></a>
